professionalSummary.title: E-commerce Operations Specialist | Amazon Marketplace | AI-Driven Systems
professionalSummary.tagline: I build stable e-commerce operations by turning recurring chaos into repeatable systems.
professionalSummary.description: Results-driven E-commerce Operations Specialist with 7+ years of experience across Amazon marketplace management, catalog operations, customer experience, inventory coordination, and process optimization. Proven ability to manage day-to-day execution while improving systems that reduce errors, save time, and support growth. Experienced in Amazon Seller Central, listing optimization, account health, Voice of Customer analysis, and AI-assisted workflows using ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude. Strong operator mindset focused on ownership, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.

dailyRhythm.title: Daily Marketplace Operations
dailyRhythm.description: Balancing execution, risk management, and optimization to keep accounts healthy and scalable.
tasks: Account Health: Monitor metrics, defects, and policy risks.
Catalog Operations: Update listings, variations, images, and backend data.
Inventory Oversight: Track stock levels, shipment issues, and replenishment needs.
Customer Experience: Resolve inquiries, defects, returns, and recurring pain points.
Content Optimization: Improve listings and A+ assets for better conversion.
VOC Analysis: Use reviews and returns data to guide improvements.
Documentation: Maintain SOPs and scalable internal systems.
